status: implementation prerequisites; not admission or validated game behavior

primary_evidence.constraint: Gorishi reward must work on the opponent turn as well as the owner turn. Quest own-turn restriction remains separate.

source_findings.finding: Published damage event contains target and actual dealt amount but no controller. damage_source supports minion identity for entity callbacks, not complete owner attribution.
Effect context has owner, including spells with source=None. This owner must be passed explicitly; inferring current player is incorrect during opponent-turn effects.
Attacker and defender damage are separate calls; retaliation belongs to defender controller. Hero attackers have no minion source. Spill and cleave need the original attacker controller.
Returns damage including overkill and armor. Prevented damage returns zero. Exact-two checks must use resolved damage, not pre-modification requested amount.

required_contract: Carry explicit damage controller, source identity where available, and causal origin through direct effects, hero powers, combat, retaliation, spill, delayed events and nested effects.
Do not assign fatigue or unattributed damage to current player as a fallback.
Snapshot target controller before subsequent death/removal/control changes.
Advance Quest only on owner turn for owner-attributed damage to an enemy with resolved amount exactly two.

Reward observes both turns; distinguish reward-generated damage to avoid accidental infinite self-trigger recursion. Establish multiple reward stacking semantics from independent evidence before admission.
Preserve event queue ordering, lifesteal/poison attribution, death checkpoints and simultaneous damage batches.
